From now on, you can make the pose you want right away without adjusting the avatar joints one by one and without any complicated process. Just enter the text or image, and the AI will make the pose you want fast and easy on its own. To access the AI Pose Generator, click on the main menu, go to **Avatar**, and select **AI Pose Generator**. If there is an avatar or costume in the existing project file, a pop-up that asks for removal appears. The AI Pose Generator can be used as an empty project file or save the file you are working on first and then use it. Press the **Proceed** button to run the AI Pose Generator. In the AI Pose Generator window, you can select one of the two ways: **prompt** or **image**. - **Prompt:** You can enter the text you want or select a keyword to create an image. - **Image Menu:** You can upload an image file and create a pose right away. ### Using the Prompt Method 1. **Select Gender:** Choose between female or male. The mannequin of the selected gender appears in the 3D window. 2. **Enter Text Prompt:** Explain the pose you want. Click on the keyword suggestion icon on the right to select recommended keywords. 3. **Clear Prompt:** Use the Clear Prompt icon to delete all text prompts and keywords if needed. The Pose Generator always creates a new image even if it is the same prompt. However, if you activate the **Maintain Prompt** icon, you can add a new prompt with the existing results as much as possible and update it. ### Creating a New Pose Now, let's enter a prompt in the description and create a new pose together. - **Gender:** Male - **Text Prompt:** Tennis After entering the prompt, click the **Generate** button to create the image. If you need corrections, use the **Clear Prompt** icon or adjust the existing prompt with the **Maintain Prompt** icon. Once you are satisfied with the generated image, save it as a pose file by pressing the **Save** button. ### Using the Image Method Next, let's create a pose using the image file. Select the **Image** tab and choose the gender. After selecting male or female, upload the desired image. To recognize the image well, the whole body should be visible from the head to the toes. After successfully adding the image file, click the **Generate** button to create a pose. Check the pose and save it as a pose file. ## Pattern Drafter Function In this version, the **Pattern Drafter** function has been added to create accurate and realistic parametric patterns based on actual data. ### Creating a Pattern 1. **Call Avatar:** First, call the avatar from the library. 2. **Run the 2D Pattern Drafter:** Click and run the 2D pattern drafter in the top main menu. 3. **Select Costume Category:** Currently, only the top t-shirt pattern is possible, and various categories such as pants and skirts will be developed later. ### Measurement Configuration In the pattern drafter, you can set up measurement items to create a pattern.
